sources.title: qwen-image-realism-lora: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview qwen-image-realism-lora is a LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) module trained for the Qwen-Image text-to-image model that specializes in photorealistic image generation across portraits, landscapes, and complex scenes. Built and maintained by flymy-ai, this adapter enhances the base Qwen-Image model with improved facial detail, color accuracy, lighting control, and ethnic diversity ...
